source.original_text:
Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv:2609.06905v1, B20 and Lemma B4 perturbation expansion Ex28–Ex34. ASTIS auxiliary real Hilbert generalization with all structural assumptions explicit; not a verbatim source theorem.
Let H be a complete real Hilbert space, allowing the zero space. Let A,G,Inv:H→H be bounded real-linear endomorphisms. Assume A,G,Inv are selfadjoint, A commutes with Inv, Inv G=G Inv=I, and A²+G²=I. Every one of these structural conditions is an explicit hypothesis of this auxiliary algebra theorem. For arbitrary u,v,r∈H define C(a,b)=(||a||²−||b||²)/2−⟨A(Inv a),b⟩. Then C(u+Gr,v−Ar)−C(u,v)=⟨u,Inv r⟩+||r||²/2. The half, plus sign, operator order and same three operators are exact. This is an ASTIS Hilbert-space auxiliary generalization of the algebra in Chen–Chewi–Lu–Zhang's PBPS B20 and Lemma B4 expansion Ex28–Ex34, rather than a claim that the paper states a theorem for arbitrary Hilbert operators. No positivity, finite dimension, spectral gap, surjectivity or probability hypothesis is needed by this algebra identity. The actual PBPS consumer constructs all seven operator facts internally on its same centered space. Arbitrary r is not yet the paper's r_rho; the actual H/K/B27 adapter and B4/B28 decay proof remain open.

{H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H]
    (A G Inv : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G)
    (hInv : IsSelfAdjoint Inv) (hAInv : Commute A Inv)
    (hInvG : Inv * G = 1) (hGInv : G * Inv = 1)
    (hSquares : A * A + G * G = 1)
    (u v r : H) :
    let C : H → H → ℝ := fun u v =>
      (‖u‖^2 - ‖v‖^2)/2 - inner ℝ (A (Inv u)) v
    C (u + G r) (v - A r) - C u v =
      inner ℝ u (Inv r) + ‖r‖^2/2
decoder_context: H is one complete real Hilbert space; bounded real-linear endomorphism multiplication is composition and 1 is its identity operator.
IsSelfAdjoint means selfadjoint for the real Hilbert adjoint; Commute A Inv means their two composition orders are equal.

Every displayed operator condition is an explicit hypothesis. The functional C is exactly the displayed let definition, not an independently assumed object. u,v,r range over all H, including the zero space.

import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.HilbertCorrectorPerturbation
noncomputable section
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_corrector_perturbation
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H]
    [CompleteSpace H]
    (A G Inv : H →L[ℝ] H)
    (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) (hG : IsSelfAdjoint G)
    (hInv : IsSelfAdjoint Inv) (hAInv : Commute A Inv)
    (hInvG : Inv * G = 1) (hGInv : G * Inv = 1)
    (hSquares : A * A + G * G = 1)
    (u v r : H) :
    let C : H → H → ℝ := fun u v =>
      (‖u‖^2 - ‖v‖^2)/2 - inner ℝ (A (Inv u)) v
    C (u + G r) (v - A r) - C u v =
      inner ℝ u (Inv r) + ‖r‖^2/2
 := by
  dsimp only
  have ha (x y : H) : inner ℝ (A x) y=inner ℝ x (A y) := hA.isSymmetric x y
  have hg (x y : H) : inner ℝ (G x) y=inner ℝ x (G y) := hG.isSymmetric x y
  have hi (x y : H) : inner ℝ (Inv x) y=inner ℝ x (Inv y) := hInv.isSymmetric x y
  have hIG (x : H) : Inv (G x)=x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun L : H →L[ℝ] H => L x) hInvG
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply] using h
  have hSq (x : H) : A (A x)+G (G x)=x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun L : H →L[ℝ] H => L x) hSquares
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply] using h
  have hEnergy (x : H) : ‖A x‖^2+‖G x‖^2=‖x‖^2 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : H => inner ℝ z x) (hSq x)
    rw [inner_add_left,ha (A x) x,hg (G x) x] at h
    simpa only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using h
  have hLinear (x : H) : Inv (A (A x))+G x=Inv x := by
    calc
      Inv (A (A x))+G x=Inv (A (A x))+Inv (G (G x)) := by rw [hIG]
      _ = Inv (A (A x)+G (G x)) := by rw [map_add]
      _ = Inv x := congrArg Inv (hSq x)
  have hMixed : inner ℝ (A (Inv u)) (A r)+inner ℝ u (G r)=inner ℝ u (Inv r) := by
    rw [ha (Inv u) (A r),hi u (A (A r)),
      ← inner_add_right,hLinear r]
  rw [norm_add_sq_real,norm_sub_sq_real]
  simp only [map_add,hIG,inner_add_left,inner_sub_right,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [real_inner_comm v (A r)]
  nlinarith only [hEnergy r,hMixed]

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Analysis.HilbertCorrectorPerturbation

steps.title: Expose the exact functional and typed selfadjoint identities
steps.text: Unfold only C. State each selfadjointness consequence as an equality of real inner products on the same H, avoiding coercion-sensitive rewrites. No mathematical assumption is added.
steps.lean:
dsimp only
  have ha (x y : H) : inner ℝ (A x) y=inner ℝ x (A y) := hA.isSymmetric x y
  have hg (x y : H) : inner ℝ (G x) y=inner ℝ x (G y) := hG.isSymmetric x y
  have hi (x y : H) : inner ℝ (Inv x) y=inner ℝ x (Inv y) := hInv.isSymmetric x y
steps.detail: Exact compiled contiguous BODY span; preceding local definitions and inherited Hilbert structures remain in scope.

steps.title: Evaluate the inverse and square-sum operator equalities
steps.text: Apply Inv G=I and A²+G²=I to an arbitrary vector x. These give vector equalities without dividing by a scalar or assuming a nonzero space.
steps.lean:
have hIG (x : H) : Inv (G x)=x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun L : H →L[ℝ] H => L x) hInvG
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply] using h
  have hSq (x : H) : A (A x)+G (G x)=x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun L : H →L[ℝ] H => L x) hSquares
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply] using h
steps.detail: Exact compiled contiguous BODY span; preceding local definitions and inherited Hilbert structures remain in scope.

steps.title: Obtain the energy identity
steps.text: Take the inner product of the square-sum equality with x and move A and G across the inner product by selfadjointness. The two summands become squared norms.
steps.lean:
have hEnergy (x : H) : ‖A x‖^2+‖G x‖^2=‖x‖^2 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : H => inner ℝ z x) (hSq x)
    rw [inner_add_left,ha (A x) x,hg (G x) x] at h
    simpa only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] using h
steps.detail: Exact compiled contiguous BODY span; preceding local definitions and inherited Hilbert structures remain in scope.

steps.title: Recover the remaining linear operator
steps.text: Use Inv(G(Gx))=Gx and linearity to write Inv(A(Ax))+Gx=Inv(A(Ax)+G(Gx))=Inv x. This avoids any additional A–G commutation hypothesis.
steps.lean:
have hLinear (x : H) : Inv (A (A x))+G x=Inv x := by
    calc
      Inv (A (A x))+G x=Inv (A (A x))+Inv (G (G x)) := by rw [hIG]
      _ = Inv (A (A x)+G (G x)) := by rw [map_add]
      _ = Inv x := congrArg Inv (hSq x)
steps.detail: Exact compiled contiguous BODY span; preceding local definitions and inherited Hilbert structures remain in scope.

steps.title: Identify the mixed linear contribution
steps.text: Move A and Inv through the inner products and apply the preceding vector identity with x=r. Thus the sum of the two surviving u-linear terms is exactly the claimed right-hand linear term.
steps.lean:
have hMixed : inner ℝ (A (Inv u)) (A r)+inner ℝ u (G r)=inner ℝ u (Inv r) := by
    rw [ha (Inv u) (A r),hi u (A (A r)),
      ← inner_add_right,hLinear r]
steps.detail: Exact compiled contiguous BODY span; preceding local definitions and inherited Hilbert structures remain in scope.

steps.title: Expand and cancel the perturbation terms
steps.text: Expand the two squared norms and C cross term. Since Inv Gr=r, the increment is ⟨u,Gr⟩+⟨v,Ar⟩+(||Gr||²−||Ar||²)/2+⟨A Inv u,Ar⟩−⟨Ar,v⟩+||Ar||². Real symmetry cancels the v terms, the energy identity reduces the quadratic terms to ||r||²/2, and the mixed identity gives ⟨u,Inv r⟩. The result retains the exact positive half.
steps.lean:
rw [norm_add_sq_real,norm_sub_sq_real]
  simp only [map_add,hIG,inner_add_left,inner_sub_right,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [real_inner_comm v (A r)]
  nlinarith only [hEnergy r,hMixed]

reconstruction.text:
For every complete real Hilbert space H (also allowing the zero space), every three bounded real-linear endomorphisms A, G, Inv of H, and every u,v,r in H, suppose A, G, and Inv are selfadjoint; A commutes with Inv; Inv composed with G and G composed with Inv both equal the identity; and A composed with A plus G composed with G equals the identity. Define, for every a,b in H,
C(a,b) = (||a||² - ||b||²)/2 - <A(Inv(a)),b>.
Then
C(u+G(r), v-A(r)) - C(u,v) = <u,Inv(r)> + ||r||²/2.
The function C is locally defined from the already quantified A and Inv. Its two argument names do not rebind the theorem's fixed u,v outside the function. The conclusion is an exact real identity for every triple u,v,r, with no positivity, nonzero-dimension, scalar-parameter, or probabilistic premise.
